versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the find-cpa-firm skill.
- Enables finding, shortlisting, and enriching US business-focused accounting and tax (CPA) firms.
- Supports filters for industry, services, specialization, US state, company size, and ratings.
- Excludes personal/consumer tax, non-US firms, DIY, in-house hires, and software comparisons.
- Integrates with the ServiceGraph API for access to a 100k+ US firm directory.
- Detailed instructions for authentication, API usage, and example queries for common B2B accounting needs.
